meaning: A thin stick used to make thread from wool.
example: She touched the spindle with her finger.

meaning: A machine with a wheel that makes thread.
example: The old woman sat at a spinning wheel.

meaning: A long, thin line of cloth used for sewing.
example: The thread came out of her hands.

meaning: In old stories, a woman with magic power.
example: The wise women gave gifts to the baby.

meaning: A big meal for many people.
example: The king made a great feast.

meaning: A small bed for a baby.
example: The baby lay in a golden cradle.

meaning: To wish good things for someone.
example: They will bless our child.

meaning: Something you give to a person. Also a special talent.
example: The first gift was goodness.

meaning: A small area of water.
example: A frog jumped out of the pond.

meaning: A small green animal that jumps and lives near water.
example: The frog said her wish would come true.

meaning: A plate made of gold.
example: The king had only twelve golden plates.

meaning: A small soft hat.
example: Each wore a tall red cap.

meaning: Wanting to hurt other people.
example: Her words were cold and cruel.

meaning: To hurt your skin with something sharp.
example: She will prick her finger on a spindle.

meaning: Words that bring bad luck or pain to someone.
example: The thirteenth wise woman made a curse.

meaning: Magic words that change things.
example: They said a wicked woman put a spell on them.

meaning: A man who fights for his country.
example: The soldiers took every spindle.

meaning: A stick with a fire at the end.
example: He put the torch to the wood.

meaning: The grey powder after a fire.
example: There was only a heap of grey ash.

meaning: Moving in a smooth, beautiful way.
example: She was tall and graceful.

meaning: A tall, thin part of a castle.
example: She climbed the old tower.

meaning: Covered with a red-brown color from old metal.
example: The door had a rusty lock.

meaning: A small metal tool that opens a lock.
example: In the lock there was a golden key.

meaning: A sound that comes back from a wall.
example: Her steps made an echo.

meaning: Ready to sleep.
example: I am so sleepy.

meaning: A grey bird that lives in towns.
example: The pigeons sat on the roof.

meaning: A servant in charge of the wine and the house.
example: The butler sat on a barrel.

meaning: A long stick for cooking meat over a fire.
example: The spit stopped in the middle of its turn.

meaning: A thick wall of bushes.
example: A hedge of thorns grew around the castle.

meaning: A sharp point on a plant like a rose.
example: The thorns were as long as a finger.

meaning: A part of a tree or bush that grows out from the middle.
example: The branch bent back.

meaning: A long metal knife that soldiers use.
example: He took out his sword.

meaning: A flat piece of metal that protects a soldier.
example: He had no golden shield.

meaning: An old story that people tell for many years.
example: The story became a legend.

meaning: A flower on a tree.
example: The air smelled of apple blossoms.

meaning: A small hotel with a restaurant.
example: He stopped at the inn.

meaning: The person who owns an inn.
example: The innkeeper brought him some soup.

meaning: A round thing that turns.
example: The wheel went round and round.

meaning: A hard hat that protects the head.
example: There were pieces of old helmets.

meaning: A person made of stone or metal.
example: They looked like statues.

meaning: A long soft seat.
example: She lay on a couch under the window.

meaning: To go down on your knees.
example: He knelt next to the couch.

meaning: A special chair for a king or queen.
example: They sat on their old thrones.

meaning: To stop sleeping.
example: Briar Rose opened her eyes and woke up.

meaning: To start sleeping.
example: She fell asleep on the floor.

meaning: To make the sound of meat in hot oil.
example: The goose began to sizzle.

meaning: To open into flowers.
example: Thousands of roses were in bloom.

meaning: A party when two people get married.
example: The wedding was held a few days later.
